issues.description: Field 'firstName' in class de.tum.in.ase.eist.model.Person has different access modifiers between the template and the solution. In the template (src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java) the field is declared 'private String firstName;' (lines 24-26). In the solution (src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java) the same field is declared 'public String firstName;' (lines 24-26). This inconsistency may confuse students about intended encapsulation and the use of the provided getter/setter methods.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the field visibility consistent between template and solution. Prefer keeping 'firstName' private and using the existing getFirstName()/setFirstName() methods. Update the solution's Person.java to declare 'firstName' as private (or conversely update the template with a comment explaining the intentional public exposure) so students are not confused about encapsulation expectations.
